title: A sole trade loss: carry sideways, carry back, and which applies first
description: A signed-in walk through Making Tax Digital for Income Tax's losses and claims for a self-employment business: sign in, take out Resident, get HMRC's access for the year, then set a loss sideways against this year's other income and back against an earlier year, and say which claim applies first.
